findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Interrupted native capture leaves a live mapping in the unfinished buffer; checkpoint replacement erases a handed spend and permits redispatch
findings.evidence_kind: EXECUTED deterministic probes plus independent sys.settrace/sys.setprofile reproduction with production functions unmodified
smallest_reproduction: Use _desk fixture with BudgetReader.following(lambda: (o.ledgers, o.experiments)); save a canonical pre-spend BudgetLedger checkpoint.
Dispatch the original admitted action once; its ordinary executor settles run.1.
Interrupt _items for the first or second mapping during _retain_handing, and interrupt the immediate recovery at the same checkpoint. No account or reader private state is changed by the probe.
After pin raises, _uncompared contains the original mutable pair (type tuple), not a _RetainedHanding. Replace o.ledgers[lid] with the saved checkpoint through the execution-owned mapping.
Remove fault injection and dispatch the original admitted action. Recovery reparses the now-restored mapping and the action executes a second time.
findings.actual_result: All six repeated-interruption combinations (KeyboardInterrupt, RecursionError, MemoryError x first/second mapping) print dispatch_refused False, executor_calls 2 and no divergence. The old action is readmitted after losing the handed spend.
findings.expected_result: A later verification cannot accept a restored budget as current while the original interrupted handing has not been authoritatively recovered. Either preserve and compare the originally handed spend or retain a genuine unresolved refusal; rereading a changed live mapping cannot complete its historical comparison.
findings.controls: All six single-interruption combinations refuse redispatch and retain executor_calls 1. Both completed-native-retention interrupted _handed controls recover an unchanged detached checkpoint without poisoning it.
findings.trust_boundary: The owner callback returns ordinary public dicts and performs a supported detached checkpoint replacement. No malicious serializer, key hooks, private account mutation or introspection is required by the behavior. The first probe injects exceptions at _items; the independent trace_repro.py instead leaves every production function unmodified and uses CPython trace/profile hooks to raise KeyboardInterrupt at the native capture and immediate recovery checkpoints. Both are bounded fault-injection instrumentation, not an alleged attacker capability. The spend was handed at a verification, outside the expressly unobservable spend-and-rollback-between-verifications limit.
findings.proposed_correction: Do not treat a raw mutable mapping in _uncompared as a recoverable immutable historical handing. Retain each completed native-entry capture progressively before subsequent interruptible work, and keep uncaptured work explicitly unresolved rather than declaring it compared by rereading replacement mappings. Establish a safe recovery contract for interruption before the first stable capture without permanently sealing an honest reader merely because of interruption; add controls at _retain_handing/_items, not only _handed.

findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Retained raw charge history is compared with normalized owner history and permanently rejects an honest detached checkpoint
findings.evidence_kind: EXECUTED deterministic synthetic probe with non-interrupted control
smallest_reproduction: Start a following reader with an empty ledger. Hand a ledger built through public BudgetLedger/BudgetCharge constructors with realized=1 and from_general_pool=1 (ordinary integers).
Interrupt once immediately before _account reads that newly handed charge; the native unread-entry barrier retains it.
Restore the unchanged ledger through BudgetLedger.from_dict(payload). Its owner normalizes the numeric charge fields to floats.
Read the restored account. Reconciliation hashes the raw retained charge to a different history from the owner-normalized read-back and permanently marks the honest account as rewritten.
findings.actual_result: OwnerUnavailable: budget ledger a rewrote its history; _diverged permanently contains the account. Raw retained history 04541d50a680590dfa7a848845aa2b9fe2215f584cf835401405b5cbad3e3032 differs from restored history d5726c42faecb2749a9623325955a9114136d9d8e1205b6f30b9c4104d60d475.
findings.expected_result: An unchanged checkpoint that the canonical owner accepts and normalizes must recover after an interrupt, with no permanent divergence absent evidence of corruption. The ordinary non-interrupted read/restore control is accepted.
findings.trust_boundary: Public owner constructors and public owner round-trip only; no custom execution-side code in the account, no private mutation. Integers in float-valued constructor fields are accepted by the canonical owner. The failure is semantic availability, not false admission.
findings.proposed_correction: Canonicalize retained entries through the same owner read-back representation used by _read_once before hashing and updating _seen. Reuse owner normalization rather than introducing another history authority; add integer/float and other supported normalization round-trip controls.

tested_transitions: Native mapping capture interrupted on first or second map, once versus twice, for KeyboardInterrupt/RecursionError/MemoryError; public mapping replacement after the failed pin; dispatch outcome checked (12 combinations).
Completed native capture followed by interrupted _handed and optionally interrupted immediate recovery; honest detached checkpoint reuse (2 controls).
Public integer-valued BudgetCharge -> interrupted unread barrier -> normalized detached checkpoint -> next read; non-interrupted baseline (2 controls).
Normal admission, observed-spend rollback, structural seal and unread spend -> AdmissionRecord -> replay_admission: all four REPRODUCED with correct FEASIBLE/MISSING_INFORMATION status.
Authorities.from_snapshot is nonlive and ExecutionDesk refuses it in all four record cases.

Static inspection of changed owners.py lifecycle, barrier identity reconciliation, seal checks, before/after entry matching, recovery cleanup; supporting canonical BudgetCharge load/serialization and AdmissionRecord/replay/live dispatch boundaries.

Independent unmodified-source CPython trace/profile checkpoints: native capture interrupted, immediate recovery interrupted, pending raw mapping replaced through owner checkpoint restore, stale admitted action incorrectly dispatches again.
missing_coverage: No real OS signal/heap exhaustion was induced; interruptions are deterministic injections at exact function checkpoints, matching the strategy of existing R15 controls.
No exhaustive bytecode-interruption or concurrency exploration; no process-crash or cross-process durable recovery.
No new model applicability, system-state or unit-registry implementation probes; these mechanisms are unchanged by the repair.
No scientific validation, certification, full FAST, external providers, network requests, installs or source changes.
Recovery normalization may have more equivalent-type cases beyond the executed integer/float charge example; not claimed as demonstrated.
